_instructions: Sidecar for the frozen egolife_queries.json bank. The bank file is never edited; tier and cue metadata live here keyed by query id.
bank_sha256 is the hash of egolife_queries.json at annotation time; the scoring harness refuses to score if it has changed.

ambiguity_expected is a manual pass over the EgoLife 12:00 DenseCaption SRT files BEFORE scoring: true where captions mention multiple instances of the class (e.g. 我将纸杯叠到一起) or two distinct placements of it in the same period. These are independent human labels, not derived from Aegis candidates.

t3_prompt cue words (yesterday / two days ago / ...) are derived mechanically from asked_at.date - observed_at.date. They deliberately avoid naming the anchor. There are no per-instance visual-trait or activity labels in EgoLife, so those cue types are NOT IMPLEMENTED on this dataset.
t4_prompt uses the caption observed_at as the oracle timestamp. It is a diagnostic upper bound, not a patient-facing prompt.
Freeze this file and record its sha256 in the report before the first score. Do not relabel after seeing results.
